notes.subject: na
notes.rationale: Heburukan bɛ duba-kuma cogo (jussive) di; Bamanankan ka 'na' wajibiya ka n'a fɔ walasa a ka ye tiɲɛ-ɲini ye

notes.subject: ⟨o min ye⟩
notes.rationale: Nɔnabila min bɛ Yawe ɲɛfɔ, Bamanankan ka a wajibiya

notes.subject: i
notes.rationale: Kuma in bɛ tɛmɛ kelen-kelen bɛɛ la (dɔko lajebaga) — a ye sannu-ka-duguba walima sɔrɔdaga ye

notes.subject: מציון
notes.rationale: Siyon (Jerushalayim kulu) tɔgɔ bɛ to a fɔcogo la, sɛbɛnni-yɛlɛma dɔrɔn

translation: Yawe na i duba Siyon fɛ, ⟨o min ye⟩ sankolow ni dugukolo dilan.
